title: ::: PSS-OFF 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Passoff Reading 038 ]

blocks.text: It is people who turn a city from a collection of streets and buildings into a community. No matter how well a city is designed, it will not ultimately come to life, unlessit inspires the love and loyalty of the people who live and work in it.
